caption: The drawing features two ceramic sculptures, each depicting a pair of birds perched closely together on a pedestal base. The sculpture on the left shows two birds facing each other with their beaks touching, and their bodies are primarily gray-beige with dark green wings and subtle red markings on their heads and necks. The pedestal base is light beige in color and slightly flared at the bottom. The sculpture on the right also depicts two birds with their beaks touching; these birds have grayish bodies, wings with blue-black shading, and prominent red spots on their shoulders and heads. Their pedestal base is lighter in color, more cylindrical, and rounded at the bottom. Both sculptures have minimal detail in the background, which is a plain, light beige color, and the composition is framed by a simple rectangular line close to the edges of the drawing.
title: Chalkware Lovebirds
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
